title: Sync
subtitle: End-to-end encrypted. Your server never sees your data.
status.pending: Waiting for approval from another device
server.label: Server URL
server.hint: Your self-hosted Corvid sync server, for example https://sync.example.org
user.label: Account name
user.hint: Visible to the server. Not your passphrase.
pass.label: Passphrase
pass.hint: Never leaves this device. If you forget it you need your recovery key.
token.label: Invite token (if your server needs one)
device.label: Name of this device
device.hint: Visible to the server and your other devices.
recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.body: This is the only way back in if you lose your passphrase and all your devices. It is shown once. Store it offline.
recovery.confirm: I have saved my recovery key
collections.title: What to sync
devices.title: Devices
devices.fingerprint: Check that this code matches the new device: {fp}
devices.revokeNote: A revoked device cannot read anything written from now on. It keeps what it already has.
security.title: Passphrase and recovery key
integrity.title: Rejected data
integrity.body: {n} items failed their integrity check and were not applied. The server may be faulty or tampered with.
modules.unavailable.title: Modules not available on this device
modules.unavailable.body: These modules are in your synced list but cannot run here. They are kept and will return on devices that support them.
danger.title: Delete account
danger.body: Removes all synced data from the server. Data on your devices is kept.
error.wrongPassphrase: Wrong passphrase, or the server could not be verified.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rollback: The server's data went backwards. Stop syncing and check your server.
status.pendingCode: On a device you already trust, approve this device only if it shows the same code:
